style: cel-shaded toon game art, thick dark outline, flat shading, neon rim light, carnival stage glow
notes: One art style for the whole project, repeated word for word at the head of every prompt (rule F.1c); photographic wording is banned everywhere. Every sprite that takes part in the mechanic declares its orientation in words (rule C.8), and the radially symmetric ones say so explicitly so nothing is mirrored or rotated by accident. No prompt argues about background colour - the pipeline cuts the background away (rule F.1b), so atmosphere and glow are the job of the two backgrounds, not of the sprites. Two sprites are 9-sliced (sprite_lane_track, sprite_btn_turn) and ask for a plain stretchable middle with identical ends, because their .meta carries a real spriteBorder; the lane rail's border is horizontal only, since it is drawn about 99x23 px and a vertical border would overlap itself. Every other sprite is square framed, which keeps the drawn size square and the aspect check quiet. There is no audio asset of any kind (rule C.20). No prompt contains the app name and no sprite carries lettering (hard rule 1) - the splash mark is the crystal inside the guard ring, an abstract shape. The icon hero is the single gold crystal.
